messages:
Anita (Partnerships): Quick proposal: change SI lead handoffs for a small marketplace pilot. want ops/ROE agreement before enabling.
Devon (SI): whats the change?
Anita (Partnerships): move from first-claim to a 48h staging window to let Sales + SI confirm account mapping, then lock to SI. aim to reduce bounced leads.
Sam (Sales): 48h OK usually. need fast-path if customer asks partner same day.
Priya (Field Eng): add an "urgent-intro" tag on intake to bypass staging. define who can set it.
Devon (SI): also: if SI has CRM relationship flag -> immediate claim. otherwise staging applies.
Anita (Partnerships): draft rules: 1) si_relationship=true -> immediate assign; 2) urgent-intro -> immediate assign; 3) else -> staging queue 48h then lock or return to Sales.
Sam (Sales): SFDC fields needed: lead_claim_status, claim_timestamp, si_relationship_bool, urgent_flag, staging_deadline.
Priya (Field Eng): mock sheet + opsbot pseudo-rule:
```
if si_relationship_bool or urgent_flag:
  owner = si_owner
else:
  owner = staging_queue
  staging_deadline = now + 48h
```
Anita (Partnerships): add one-click confirm/release email to Sales+SI at claim start.
leadbot: new lead T-2427 created (origin: cloud-marketplace). account=AcmeCo, region=NA, tags=[marketplace, hw-partner], si_relationship_bool=false
Devon (SI): dedupe by account_domain, manual stitch for duplicates, and 24h no-contact hold after claim to avoid parallel outreach.
Sam (Sales): watch shared domains/subsidiaries; allow manual override.
Anita (Partnerships): next steps: Priya to post sheet + SFDC fields (EOD). Ops to prototype opsbot + staging queue (Fri). Sales to provide subsidiary examples. Partnerships to publish ROE + partner one-pager.
Priya (Field Eng): sheet link: https://tiny.redwood/trellis-mapping
Devon (SI): we'll run two test leads: normal and urgent.
Sam (Sales): request dashboard: avg time-to-claim and % urgent-escalations.
Anita (Partnerships): partnerships + sales ops to own metrics; add to roadmap.
leadbot: staging_deadline for T-2427 = 1763335140
Devon (SI): will report after tests. target pilot flip Tue 9am PT if green. :thumbsup: 
Anita (Partnerships): i'll post ROE + one-pager for sign-off by EOD Mon.
Sam (Sales): thanks.
Priya (Field Eng): thanks all.
